limit_scope: Per parent expansion group, not a global engine concurrency bound.
timing_failures: All listing attempts returned identical rows. One paired limit-32 attempt and the pilot limit-128 attempt exited 1 during session cleanup; no clean latency median is claimed.
heap_metric: Peak sampled Go HeapAlloc, including uncollected garbage. The persistent engine has a pre-command heap; this is not peak live memory or a per-command RSS increment.
controls: Rust and Go edited test cohorts retain the same module on both arms, 4 balanced pairs per size. Small-fixture timing variation and CPU/GC pressure preclude attributing every difference to the limit; at Go size 16 the bound never binds.
metadata_annotation: The historical diagnostic label in the smaller-cohort metadata names the inherited interface-field experiment. The saved driver, expansion counters and limit changes identify the actual per-parent limit experiment. Original files are preserved.
pilot_driver: sweep_measure_listing.py was reconstructed by reversing the later phase-sampling additions; it was not captured at the start of the pilot.
baseline_sources: Previous engine overlays are archived in ../interface-field-snapshots; engine-overlay.json retains original absolute source paths.
